title: Sample RN app: scaffold with React Navigation (3-4 screens)
description: Phase 4. Create a sample React Native app (bare RN, not Expo) mirroring the Compose sample music app. Screens: Home (playlist list), Search Results, Playlist Detail, Track Detail. Use FlintProvider + FlintNavigationContainer. Annotate all screens with Flint hooks/components. Must run on the connected Pixel 6a.
